subject.title: fix: inject only shared auth into macos dashboard

question: Should the macOS Dashboard embedded browser receive only configured shared gateway token/password auth, or may it reuse native/stored operator device tokens for parity with native websocket clients?
rationale: The linked issue and this PR treat native device-token injection as a browser boundary bug, while the sibling parity issue/PR expects native/operator token reuse; the repository needs one maintainer-owned auth policy before either branch lands.

options.title: Adopt shared-token-only browser injection
options.body: Rebase this PR, update the current endpoint-reload path, and close or redirect the sibling native-token parity direction.

options.title: Keep native-token parity
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue the sibling parity path that lets the Dashboard browser reuse native/operator auth.

options.title: Accept fallback removal as an upgrade break
options.body: Land shared-token-only behavior while documenting that users relying only on stored native operator auth must use shared token, password, or browser auth flow instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared-token-only browser injection
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, update the current endpoint-reload path, and close or redirect the sibling native-token parity direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the native Dashboard auth/window surface affected by both policy directions.
